seo.title: Waymark — An AI companion that stays beside you at every decision
seo.description: The bigger the decision, the more you need someone beside you — not someone to decide for you. Waymark remembers your decisions, reaches out when you waver, and brings stories from people who walked the same path. Coming soon.

hero.sub:
So that you, standing before decisions big and small, are never alone in the moment.
At every fork, beside you.

empathy.title: The bigger the decision, the rarer it is to have someone beside you — not someone with the answer.
empathy.p1: We all make countless decisions every day — from today's small choices to the forks that change our direction. Yet in the heaviest moments, advice is everywhere while someone to carry the weight with you is rare.
empathy.p2: Waymark isn't a tool that decides for you. It's a companion that remembers the decisions you've made, reaches out first when you waver, and offers the story of someone who walked the same road.

loop.title: Four beats that never leave you alone
loop.desc: A decision doesn't end in a single moment. From capture to reflection, Waymark walks the whole arc of a decision with you.

steps.d: Record the moment you decided — and how you felt.
When you waver, Waymark speaks to you first.
A story arrives from someone who faced the same fork.
In time, you meet that decision again.

modes.title: Four tones, one posture
modes.desc: It comes to you in the tone the moment calls for — comfort when you need comfort, clarity when you need clarity.

demo.entry: Got an offer. Better pay, but I'd be putting down the work I do.
demo.gap: Three days later, Waymark speaks first

turns.msg: You're not failing to decide. You're weighing it.
What's costly to let go — the work, or what you've built around it?

items.d: On days a decision feels heavy, it steadies your heart first.
It doesn't hand you an answer; it traces the branches of your thinking with you.
It adds the strength to carry the decision you've made forward.
It distills tangled thoughts into a shape you can decide on.

modes.reassure: The decision is always yours. Waymark never decides for you — it only lights the fork and keeps you company.

landing.heroTagline:
The on-device translation spirit that turns every sound into subtitles.
Hear it once, read it instantly.
landing.heroCtaDownload: Free Download on Mac App Store
landing.featuresTitle: Built for Mac: no silent freezes, no capture failures
landing.featuresSub: How audio gets gathered, how it gets understood, and what it leaves behind — we rebuilt all three.
landing.f1Desc: Prevents audio device loss caused by detaching bluetooth earphones during meetings. It dynamically detects your AirPods' real name and maps it automatically to the audio stream, gracefully falling back to the built-in mic if the connection drops.
landing.f2Desc: Powered primarily by local on-device neural networks, with an automatic fallback to Apple's secure server speech recognition when local language packs are unavailable, ensuring continuous and precise transcription.
landing.f3Desc: Uses the next-gen ScreenCaptureKit API to cleanly separate three audio sources — built-in mic, AirPods (Bluetooth), and system sound — without mixing. Captures Zoom, Teams, and YouTube audio losslessly; system-sound capture uses the macOS screen-recording permission.
landing.f4Desc: Your personal API key is stored in the macOS Keychain. AI processing never passes through our servers — data goes directly from your device to Google Gemini (2.5 Flash/Pro) or OpenAI. (Only when BYOK is on in Pro: caption text for post-meeting summaries, and the recording for Enhanced Minutes, are sent with your own key. Live captions never use your key.)
landing.f5Desc: When a meeting ends, Sylphio organizes the full conversation transcript into Markdown (.md) minutes. Connect your own API key in Pro and it also writes a key summary and an Action Items checklist. Supports both real-time interpretation mode and a minutes-only mode that records without translation.
landing.f6Desc: Features a unified 720x700 spacious layout and dynamic subtitle font scaling controlled via an intuitive slider, offering optimal readability and native macOS experience.
landing.f7Desc: After a session, Sylphio re-analyzes the recording (.m4a) to produce minutes more accurate than the live captions. By default it transcribes for free and offline with on-device speech recognition (Whisper) on your Mac (one-time ~1.6 GB model download). Connect your own Gemini API key in Pro and Google Gemini 2.5 produces high-quality transcription, summary, and translation (in this case the recording is uploaded to Google). Sessions that switched audio sources are merged into one for analysis and download, and you can '정밀 재생성' (Regenerate) at any time.

landing.simSub: Get a sneak peek at how the real Sylphio app captures and translates dialogue in real-time through this web simulator.

guide.heroTagline:
The on-device translation spirit that turns every sound into subtitles.
Hear it once, read it instantly.
guide.heroCtaDownload: Free Download on Mac App Store
guide.byokTitle: Advantages of BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) Architecture
guide.byokDesc: Sylphio uses a BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) approach: you enter an API key you own. AI processing never passes through our servers — it flows directly between your device and the AI provider's endpoint, and saved keys are stored encrypted in the macOS Keychain. When a summary is created after a meeting, the caption text is sent to the AI provider you selected; when you run '정밀 회의록' (Enhanced Minutes), the recording (.m4a) is uploaded directly to Google Gemini with your own key. Live caption translation never uses your API key.
guide.geminiTitle: Get a Google Gemini API Key
guide.geminiIntro: Google Gemini understands translation context well and offers a Free Tier, so you can start without any API cost.
guide.geminiStep2: Click the Get API key button in the top left sidebar menu.
guide.geminiStep3: Click Create API key in the center, and choose Create API key in new project in the popup to generate your key.
guide.geminiStep4: Instantly copy the unique key string (starting with AIzaSy...) using the provided button and save it securely.
guide.geminiFreeDesc:
Cost: Free
Limits: Per-model requests per minute (RPM) plus a daily request cap (roughly a few dozen requests per day).
When your key is used: Generating the meeting summary after a session, and running '정밀 회의록' (Enhanced Minutes) (recording re-analysis). Live caption translation doesn't use your API key; it runs on Apple on-device translation (Google web translation is used as a fallback only if you turn it on in Settings).
If you hit the cap: Enhanced Minutes uploads audio, which is a large call, so repeating it many times a day can reach the daily cap. Try '정밀 재생성' (Regenerate) once your quota resets.
Data use: On the free tier, Google may use submitted content to improve its products. For sensitive meetings, use a paid-tier key.
guide.geminiPayDesc: To remove the daily cap, you can register billing. Input costs about $0.075 per 1M tokens.
guide.openaiIntro: OpenAI's GPT-4o-mini offers accurate language switching, good conversation summaries, and fast responses. It does require prepaid billing credit before use.
guide.openaiWarningTitle: Before you start: add billing credit
guide.openaiWarningDesc: If your OpenAI balance is $0, even a correctly created key returns a Quota Exceeded error on the first call. Add at least $5 of credit before using the key.
guide.openaiStep2: Select the key-shaped API keys menu in the left navigation bar.
guide.openaiStep3: Click + Create new secret key in the top right, name the key, and generate it.
guide.openaiStep4: Copy the sk-proj-... secret key immediately. (It cannot be viewed again once you close the popup.)
guide.openaiStep5: Navigate to Settings > Billing on the left menu, click Add to balance, and pre-charge at least $5.
guide.openaiPriceDesc:
Input: $0.150 / 1M tokens
Output: $0.600 / 1M tokens
When your key is used: Generating the meeting text summary after a session. Live caption translation runs on Apple on-device translation, so it incurs no API cost.
Note: '정밀 회의록' (Enhanced Minutes) (audio re-analysis) is Google Gemini only.
guide.appSetupTitle: Connect Your API Key in Sylphio
guide.appStep2: Click the gear button in the top-right of the main window to open Settings.
guide.appStep3: In the left menu, select the 'Pro 라이선스' (Pro License) tab. BYOK settings appear after you purchase Pro.
guide.appStep4: Turn on 'AI 요약 보고서에 외부 전문 AI 엔진 사용 (BYOK)' (Use an external AI engine for AI summary reports). Before turning it on, read the on-screen notice: caption text is sent for summaries and the recording audio for Enhanced Minutes, directly to the AI provider you choose.
guide.appStep5: Choose a model in '대상 AI 모델 선택' (Select AI model): OpenAI GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, or Gemini 2.5 Pro.
guide.appStep6: Paste your copied API key into the field (⌘ + V).
guide.appStep7: Click '유효성 검사' (Validate) and confirm '연결 성공' (Connected). From then on, an AI summary is created when a meeting ends, and running Enhanced Minutes produces high-quality Gemini minutes. (All 12 languages are unlocked by purchasing Pro.)
guide.faq1A:
Cause: Whitespace or a line break got into the API key you entered, or the key itself is invalid.
Fix: Clear the input completely, paste your key into a plain text editor to check for spaces, then copy and paste it again.
Note: The app verifies your key with the actual provider and shows the reason if it fails.
guide.faq2Q: Q2. I connected my OpenAI key, but it keeps returning "Quota Exceeded."
guide.faq2A:
Cause: Your OpenAI account balance is $0, or your card on file has expired and the account is on hold.
Fix: Check your balance at platform.openai.com and add at least $5 of credit.

privacy.intro:
PriSincera ("we") provides the macOS app Sylphio (the "App"). We do not operate any servers, and we do not collect or access your audio, recordings, captions, meeting notes, or API keys. This policy explains what data the App processes and where, and what data is sent to outside services depending on the features you turn on.
Last updated: November 15, 2026

sections.title: 1. Key principles
bullets: We do not operate any servers, and we do not collect or access your audio, recordings, transcripts, meeting notes, or API keys.
The App contains no advertising, tracking, or third-party analytics SDKs.
Data leaves your Mac only in the cases described in Sections 3–5, and always goes directly from your device to the named service.

sections.title: 2. Data processed and stored on your device
bullets: Microphone & system audio: Captured to generate live captions. System audio uses the macOS "Screen & System Audio Recording" permission (ScreenCaptureKit); screen video is never stored or transmitted. Nothing is stored when recording is off.

Meeting recordings (.m4a): Recorded only with your consent, for enhanced meeting notes. Stored in the App sandbox container; delete them individually or all at once from the "History" tab. They are removed when the App is deleted.
Captions & notes (.md, .txt): Stored in the App container and deletable from the "History" tab. Files you export are saved where you choose.
Local enhanced notes: Without an API key, recordings are transcribed on-device by a Whisper model and never transmitted.
API key: Used for the optional BYOK feature and stored in the macOS Keychain.
Settings & diagnostic log: Stored in the App container. The log does not contain conversation content, is reset on every launch, and is never transmitted.

sections.title: 3. Data processed by Apple
bullets: Speech recognition: The App uses Apple's Speech framework. If an on-device model is unavailable for the language, speech may be processed on Apple's servers, subject to Apple's Privacy Policy.
Translation: On macOS 15 or later, translation runs on-device via Apple's Translation framework.
Purchases: Pro purchases and restores are handled by Apple's In-App Purchase. We never receive payment information.

sections.title: 4. Optional: Google web translation (off by default)
sections.content:
Only if you enable "Use Google web translation when Apple translation is unavailable" in Settings, recognized caption text is sent to Google for translation when on-device translation is unavailable or fails (e.g., macOS 14 or earlier, language pack not installed, or a language pair Apple Translation does not support). Audio is never sent.
Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

sections.title: 5. Optional: Pro BYOK (your own API key)
bullets: The transfers below happen only if you are a Pro user, enter your own API key, and turn on BYOK.
Meeting summaries: caption text is sent to the AI provider you selected (Google Gemini or OpenAI) after a session. Live caption translation never uses your API key.

Enhanced notes: the meeting recording (.m4a) is uploaded to the Google Gemini API. Large files are temporarily stored by the Gemini Files API and deleted automatically per Google's policy (currently 48 hours).

Data goes directly from your device to the provider, never through our servers, and is governed by your API account terms and the provider's policies. (Google: https://policies.google.com/privacy, https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms · OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy)
Note: On the Gemini API free tier, Google may use submitted content to improve its products. For sensitive meetings, use a paid-tier key.

sections.title: 6. Local speech model download
sections.content: The first time you use local enhanced notes, after your confirmation, the App downloads a speech recognition model (~1.6 GB) from Hugging Face (argmaxinc/whisperkit-coreml). Standard request data (such as your IP address) may be visible to Hugging Face; no audio or captions are sent.

sections.title: 7. Children
sections.content: The App is not directed to children under 13 (14 in Korea) and does not knowingly process children's personal data.

sections.title: 8. Your choices
sections.content: All App data stays on your device, so you can view and delete it yourself ("History" tab, removing your API key, deleting the App). For data sent to third-party providers, contact those providers.

sections.title: 9. Changes
sections.content: We will post changes on this page and update the "Last updated" date. Material changes will also be announced in the App.

sections.title: 10. Contact
sections.content:
If you have any questions about this policy, please email us.
Email: matthew.shim@prisincera.com
